base: An obligation can look completely different once you admit that the arrangement only works because you keep absorbing the part nobody else wants.
business: The two concerns arrive in the same decision; work with the point they now share.
shadow: Because both concerns are active at once, acting on one can obscure what the other still needs.
arcApplying: The two concerns become harder to separate as exactness approaches.
arcSeparating: The fused emphasis begins to loosen after exactness.

readerCopy.body: An obligation can look completely different once you admit that the arrangement only works because you keep absorbing the part nobody else wants. When Saturn conjuncts Lilith, duty meets the part of you that has stopped accepting the old terms, so a role, promise, contract, or responsibility may need to be renegotiated rather than silently carried. You may still care about the commitment. That does not mean every condition attached to it deserves to survive. Decide what you are still willing to do, what now belongs to someone else, and what happens if the arrangement cannot make that change workable.
